title: Kitchen Reminder Ribbon
summary: Adds an accessible, rotating reminder ribbon beneath the main navigation.
behavior: Shows the highest-priority current kitchen reminder in a subtle beige, quarter-inch ribbon beneath the main navigation.
Keeps every reminder centered, italic, and on one line at every screen size.
Rotates reminders every nine seconds without visible buttons, counters, or controls and pauses on hover, focus, or reduced-motion preference.
Places a direct text action at the end of each sentence for backup, meal planning, shopping, refrigerator, frozen inventory, and weekend bulk planning pages.
